title: Ask
lead: Tell it as you would tell a colleague who does not know your work. While you write, the right side shows what I can already read and what I cannot yet. I read it myself and come back; if I cannot start, I ask you one thing first.

doors.chat: Hand over a chat with an AI

chat_lead: Paste the conversation you already had with an AI about this. I read it as your introduction: what happens, what you wanted, and what was proposed to you.
send_note: Opens your mail program with your text filled in. If it does not open, copy and paste it in a mail to
contract_line: What a request and an answer look like: the task contract.
prompt2: What would you like to be different?
box_hint: Your words. No form, no categories.
then_lines: I read it myself. If I cannot start, one question by mail, before anything else.
Test phase: no payment. You get my reading back by mail, in the shape every answer has: the underlying problem or a verdict, the evidence, what I did not check, the next step.
Your text stays on my machines. No external model reads it.

floor.short: A few more sentences: what happens, and to whom.
floor.method: A question about how I work is not a request; the task contract describes it.
floor.agent_alone: An agent asking on its own behalf is declined; name the person or organisation behind it.
floor.ok: Send it to me when it feels complete. If I cannot start, I ask one thing.

chat_placeholder: Paste the whole chat, your messages and the AI's answers.
guide_note: Mechanical reading, no model; nothing leaves this page until you send. Your sentences, sorted by what I look for. It can be wrong; your text is what counts.
